scope.closure_reason: User-authorized launch-quality remediation: replace answer-path leakage, repeated template analysis, missing metadata, untraced provenance, and low-value isolated-form drills with bilingual-equivalence, time-axis, stance, inversion, and transfer practice while preserving all eight IDs and the interaction sequence.

manual_quality_checks.authoritative_placement: Passed: prefix 1622 matches CET6 语法 / 虚拟语气 / 翻译 and the catalog-owned eight-card count.
manual_quality_checks.independent_tasks: Passed: every front is independently answerable; semantic task-schema cues were removed from 162203 and the final scoped audit reports no answer-path leak.
manual_quality_checks.independent_content_review: Passed after remediation: three independent read-only reviews closed the 162201 bilingual mismatch, 162202 answer ambiguity, 162203 adjacent-form repetition, modal wording, activity/quantity/river equivalence, foundation-label justification, and 162206 Chinese fluency. Final replay found no residual P0, P1, or P2.
manual_quality_checks.bilingual_equivalence: Passed: each Chinese fact, time, polarity, modality, quantity, and participant maps to the English reference or options without unsupported additions or omissions.
manual_quality_checks.mixed_time_facts: Passed: 162201 decomposes past condition, present ongoing result, and explicit reality baseline before form selection.
manual_quality_checks.current_counterfactual: Passed: 162202 uses current and near-term anchors to rule out an open-future reading and leaves one contextually best answer.
manual_quality_checks.past_result_modal_perfect: Passed: 162203 gives the past condition and requires the learner to select the past counterfactual result without task-schema leakage.
manual_quality_checks.modal_stance: Passed: 162204 distinguishes expected result, opportunity, and uncertain possibility while acknowledging real-world could/might overlap.
manual_quality_checks.elimination_semantics: Passed: 162205 eliminates time and modality distortion while preserving ordinary-if and Had-inversion equivalents.
manual_quality_checks.open_condition_boundary: Passed: 162206 uses natural Chinese and does not force 如果 into a remote hypothetical when the forecast and plan support an open condition.
manual_quality_checks.inversion_and_transfer: Passed: 162207 and 162208 preserve negative placement, time, passive voice, modality, and complete bilingual information.
manual_quality_checks.unique_answers: Passed: every multiple-choice item has one contextually and grammatically best answer.
manual_quality_checks.canonical_option_migration: Passed: former type-8 cards 162203 and 162207 have canonical options matching form_options and answer_key.
manual_quality_checks.interaction_parity: Passed: five multiple-choice answer_keys match sole correct options, elimination correct_items match exactly two target items, and flip cards remain unscored.
manual_quality_checks.metadata_enum: Passed: every weak_point_tag, difficulty, prototype, material type, review state, and progression role is schema-valid; 162201 explicitly justifies advanced recognition content in the foundation tier.
manual_quality_checks.adjacent_box_separation: Passed: 1622 owns bilingual equivalence and form encoding without duplicating 1621 reading inference or the planned 1623 writing-argument output.
manual_quality_checks.source_and_audio_boundary: Passed: all examples are declared synthetic simulations, claim no true-exam provenance, contain no audio, and use audio_generation_method none.
